??? quote "Dialogue"

    - Ha! *Player*! Come, stand by the great drum. Mind the patch. She mutters now, ever since the hide split at the first feast this spring.
    - Vosk says the stand is sound, bless him. The drum is not. A hide from a great horned beast of the plateau, that is what she needs, and no hunter alive should be asked to go and get one.
    - Did you hear her? The first beat on the new hide rolled down every terrace and out over the canyons! I wept, *Player*. I am not ashamed of it.
    - I drummed the four families in, and they came, every one. Ahvi sang, Hask spoke, and you told the truth. Finest night of drumming since the choosing. Maybe finer. Don't tell Hask.
    - What can an old drummer do for you?
        - *Choice:* Who are you?
        - *Choice:* Tell me about the great drum.
        - *Choice:* What are the gatherings like?

    - Thrun, drummer of the gatherings, forty-five years at it. Husband of Odda, father of Lessa, grandfather to the most serious girl in the highlands. I laugh from the belly and I drum the same way.
    - Kragvar timber, bound with rope, taller than a man. The hide was taken in my grandfather's day from a great horned plateau beast. Few are seen now, and those that are have gone wild. So I patch, and she mutters.
    - The new hide came off the Ash Mesa. Vosk and I fitted it together, two old men arguing over every lashing. She speaks clean now, and deeper than the old one, I think.
    - Every choosing, every feast, the drum calls the families and they come. Food, contests, stories, and drumming till the stars go pale. I drummed the whole night Hask was chosen, and I will fight anyone who says it wasn't the best.
    - Off you go! And if you hear a drum, come running.
